descripcion.es: Cliente, API y base de datos, con caché y error.
descripcion.en: Client, API and database, with cache and error.

contenido.es:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant C as Cliente
    participant A as API
    participant K as Caché
    participant D as Base de datos
    C->>+A: GET /pedidos/42
    A->>K: Buscar pedido 42
    alt Está en caché
        K-->>A: Pedido
    else No está
        A->>D: SELECT pedido 42
        D-->>A: Pedido
        A-)K: Guardar 5 minutos
    end
    A-->>-C: 200 OK
contenido.en:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant C as Client
    participant A as API
    participant K as Cache
    participant D as Database
    C->>+A: GET /orders/42
    A->>K: Look up order 42
    alt In cache
        K-->>A: Order
    else Not cached
        A->>D: SELECT order 42
        D-->>A: Order
        A-)K: Store for 5 minutes
    end
    A-->>-C: 200 OK
